project_name.value: Great Northern Project  Thor and Rattling Brook Deposits
project_name.justification: The article announces an agreement for the sale of the 'Viking and Great Northern Project ('Great Northern') or (the 'Project')'. The text further specifies the project hosts the 'Rattling Brook Deposit' and the 'Thor Deposit', which aligns with the authoritative project name.

company_name.justification: The authoritative company name provided is 'Magna Terra Minerals Inc.'. The article confirms this is the selling company: 'Magna Terra Minerals Inc. (the "Company" or "Magna Terra") (TSXV:MTT) is pleased to announce that it has entered into a Purchase Option Agreement... for the sale of its Viking and Great Northern Project'.

ceo_buyer.justification: The text identifies the CEO of the seller, 'Lew Lawrick, President & CEO, Magna Terra Minerals', but does not name the CEO or any executive of the buyer, Gold Hunter Resources Inc.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement is for the 'sale of its Viking and Great Northern Project'. A sale typically implies the transfer of 100% of the asset.

primary_commodity.justification: The text describes the project as having 'significant gold endowment' and mentions numerous 'gold deposits', 'gold mineralization', and 'gold grades'.

verified_article_link.justification: The article is titled 'Magna Terra Announces Agreement To Sell Great Northern Project for $9.5 Million' and details the transaction for the Great Northern Project, which includes the Thor and Rattling Brook deposits, matching the project of interest.

currency.justification: The seller, Magna Terra Minerals Inc., is headquartered in Toronto, Canada and listed on the TSXV. The buyer, Gold Hunter Resources Inc., is listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE). The currency is inferred to be Canadian Dollars (CAD) from the Canadian context of the companies, exchanges, and headquarters.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The payment schedule table shows a total cash payment of $1,500,000 over two years. 'Total | | $ | 1,500,000'

share_payments_raw.justification: The payment schedule table shows a total share value payment of $8,000,000 over two years. 'Total | | | | | $ | 8,000,000'

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: Separate values for cash and share payments were available in the source text, so this combined field is not populated per the extraction hierarchy rules.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The text specifies the total dollar value of the share payments ($8,000,000) but does not state the number of shares to be issued.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms outlined in the article do not mention any payments in the form of share warrants.

option_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms outlined in the article do not mention any payments in the form of options.

issued_share_price.justification: The number of shares to be issued is not specified, so the price per share cannot be determined from the transaction terms.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The agreement details do not include an exploration commitment defined by a specific amount of drilling meters.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The agreement details do not include a monetary exploration commitment.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The transaction terms described in the article do not mention the acquisition or retention of a Net Smelter Royalty (NSR).

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text states the project has an 'expansive 16,650 hectare land package' and that 'The Viking and Great Northern Projects are comprised of two separate claim blocks totalling 16,650 hectares'.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The text states: 'The Viking and Great Northern Projects are comprised of two separate claim blocks totalling 16,650 hectares...'

resource_size.value: 5,460,000 tonnes at an average grade of 1.45 g/t gold containing 255,000 contained ounces at a cut-off grade of 1.0 g/t gold at the Rattling Brook Deposit; and an updated open-pit constrained Indicated Mineral Resource Estimate of 817,000 tonnes at an average grade of 1.70 g/t gold for 45,000 ounces and open-pit constrained Inferred Mineral Resources of 44,000 tonnes at an average grade of 1.27 g/t gold for 1,800 ounces at a cut-off grade of 0.46 g/t gold at the Thor Deposit. The Thor Deposit also includes underground constrained Indicated Mineral Resources of 62,000 tonnes at an average grade of 2.98 g/t gold, containing 5,900 ounces, and underground constrained Inferred Mineral Resources of 23,000 tonnes at an average grade of 3.31 g/t gold, containing 2,400 ounces at a cut-off grade of 2.14 g/t gold.
resource_size.justification: The text provides resource estimates for both deposits within the project: 'An Inferred Mineral Resource Estimate of 5,460,000 tonnes at an average grade of 1.45 g/t gold containing 255,000 contained ounces at a cut-off grade of 1.0 g/t gold at the Rattling Brook Deposit; and...An updated open-pit constrained Indicated Mineral Resource Estimate of 817,000 tonnes at an average grade of 1.70 g/t gold for 45,000 ounces and open-pit constrained Inferred Mineral Resources of 44,000 tonnes at an average grade of 1.27 g/t gold for 1,800 ounces at a cut-off grade of 0.46 g/t gold at the Thor Deposit. The Thor Deposit also includes underground constrained Indicated Mineral Resources of 62,000 tonnes at an average grade of 2.98 g/t gold, containing 5,900 ounces, and underground constrained Inferred Mineral Resources of 23,000 tonnes at an average grade of 3.31 g/t gold, containing 2,400 ounces at a cut-off grade of 2.14 g/t gold.'

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The text identifies the buyer and its ticker: '...entered into a Purchase Option Agreement (the "Agreement") dated May 28, 2024 with Gold Hunter Resources Inc. ("Gold Hunter") (CSE:HUNT)...'
